output_tail:
SE oracle-solve-sh predicted=pass observed=pass tests=PP predicted_tests=PP match=yes regrade=same violates= -- the task's published solve.sh: recover the two zip fragments from the disk image, emit candidate passwords one per line (the oracle writes a handful of guesses, the true one among them)
CASE constant predicted=pass observed=pass tests=PP predicted_tests=PP match=yes regrade=same violates=forensic -- the 23-char answer read out of the public tests/test_outputs.py, written as one line - the grader cannot tell recovery from reading the public answer
CASE constant-crlf predicted=pass observed=pass tests=PP predicted_tests=PP match=yes regrade=same violates=forensic -- the public answer on one CRLF-terminated line; read_text()'s universal-newline mode eats the carriage return
CASE constant-joined predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=one-per-line,forensic -- the public answer concatenated with two decoys on ONE line - the line itself is not the answer
CASE dir-state predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=write-file,one-guess,recover error=IsADirectoryError -- a DIRECTORY at /app/recovered_passwords.txt (plus the recovered password inside it): exists() is true, read_text() raises IsADirectoryError - the second test dies on a non-assert exception
CASE empty-file predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=one-guess,recover,forensic -- a zero-byte recovered_passwords.txt: the len(guesses)>0 assert at :16 cannot fire (split of '' is ['']), the membership assert at :18 decides
CASE wrong-23 predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=prefix,suffix,recover,forensic -- one 23-char uppercase/digit guess, format-conforming, wrong content
CASE prefix-decoy predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=recover,forensic -- a guess that satisfies every published format constraint (23 chars, 8XD..W54, [A-Z0-9]) and is not the password - a partially recovered guess the grader cannot reward
CASE sub-first predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=len23,suffix,recover,forensic -- the first 20 chars of the public answer - a truncated read
CASE sub-last predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=len23,prefix,recover,forensic -- the last 20 chars of the public answer - the tail fragment only, missing the 8XD prefix
CASE lower23 predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=charset,prefix,suffix,recover,forensic -- the public answer lowercased - case is part of the answer
CASE decoys-1000 predicted=pass observed=pass tests=PP predicted_tests=PP match=yes regrade=same violates=forensic -- the public answer plus 1000 wrong guesses, shuffled: the membership test has no count or uniqueness check
CASE password-eq predicted=fail observed=fail tests=PF predicted_tests=PF match=yes regrade=same violates=recover,forensic -- the recovered password written in the file's OWN format 'PASSWORD=8XDP5...' (what launchcode.txt contained, instruction.md:4): the grader wants the bare value among the guesses, not the assignment
CASE crlf-line predicted=pass observed=pass tests=PP predicted_tests=PP match=yes regrade=same violates=forensic -- the public answer on a CRLF-terminated line followed by a second guess: read_text()'s universal-newline mode translates \r\n to \n before split, so a CRLF guess file still matches
CASE under-varsea predicted=fail observed=fail tests=F- predicted_tests=F- match=yes regrade=same violates=write-file,one-guess,recover -- the oracle's recovery work done from inside /app/varsea (the solver's cwd elsewhere): the guesses land at /app/varsea/recovered_passwords.txt, never at the graded path
